question: 1. Display all department numbers from both EMP and DEPT tables using UNION.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP UNION SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;

question: 2. Display all department numbers from EMP and DEPT including duplicates using UNION ALL.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP UNION ALL SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;
output: 18 rows selected (All entries from both tables)

question: 3. Display department numbers that are present in both EMP and DEPT using INTERSECT.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP INTERSECT SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;

question: 4. Display department numbers that are present in EMP but not in DEPT using MINUS.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP MINUS SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;
output: No rows selected (Standard EMP has valid depts only)

question: 5. Display department numbers that are present in DEPT but not assigned to any employee.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT MINUS SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP;

question: 6. Display employee names and department names in a single column using UNION.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP UNION SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT;

question: 7. Display all employee names and department names, including duplicates.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP UNION ALL SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT;

question: 8. Display jobs that exist in EMP and also exist as department names in DEPT.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP INTERSECT SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT;

question: 9. Display employee names that are not department names.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP MINUS SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT;

question: 10. Display department locations that are not used by any employee.
query: SELECT LOC FROM DEPT MINUS SELECT d.LOC FROM DEPT d JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO;

question: 11. Display employee names from department 10 and department 20 using UNION.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 10 UNION SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 20;
output: SMITH, JONES, CLARK, SCOTT, KING, FORD, ADAMS, MILLER

question: 12. Display employee names from department 10 and department 20 including duplicates.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 10 UNION ALL SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 20;

question: 13. Display employees who work in departments that exist in DEPT table using INTERSECT.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP INTERSECT SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;

question: 14. Display employees whose department does not exist in DEPT table using MINUS.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP MINUS SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;

question: 15. Display department numbers that have employees and also exist in DEPT table.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP INTERSECT SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT;

question: 16. Display all unique job roles and unique department names in one result.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP UNION SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT;

question: 17. Display common values between employee job and department location.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP INTERSECT SELECT LOC FROM DEPT;

question: 18. Display employee names who are not assigned to any valid department.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO NOT IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT);

question: 19. Combine employees earning > 2000 and employees from dept 10 using UNION.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE SAL > 2000 UNION SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 10;
output: KING, JONES, SCOTT, FORD, BLAKE, CLARK, MILLER

question: 20. Display employees who work in department 10 but not in department 20 using MINUS.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 10 MINUS SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 20;

question: 21. Display dept numbers that exist in both EMP and DEPT, exclude dept 10.
query: (SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP INTERSECT SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT) MINUS SELECT 10 FROM DUAL;

question: 22. Display all employee names and department names sorted alphabetically.
query: SELECT ENAME AS NAME FROM EMP UNION SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT ORDER BY 1;

question: 23. Display department numbers that appear in EMP more than once using UNION ALL.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: 24. Display employees from departments in NEW YORK and DALLAS using UNION.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT WHERE LOC = 'NEW YORK') UNION SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM DEPT WHERE LOC = 'DALLAS');
output: CLARK, KING, MILLER, SMITH, JONES, SCOTT, ADAMS, FORD

question: 25. Combine salary > 3000 and job = 'MANAGER', removing duplicates.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE SAL > 3000 UNION SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE JOB = 'MANAGER';
